operation.description:
Gets GitHub Actions cache storage limit for an enterprise. All organizations and repositories under this
enterprise may not set a higher cache storage limit.

OAuth tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `admin:enterprise` scope to use this endpoint.
operation.summary: Get GitHub Actions cache storage limit for an enterprise

#/components/parameters/enterprise.description: The slug version of the enterprise name.
#/components/parameters/enterprise.name: enterprise

#/components/schemas/actions-cache-stora.description: GitHub Actions cache storage policy for an enterprise.

max_cache_size_gb.description: For repositories & organizations in an enterprise, the maximum size limit for the sum of all caches in a repository, in gigabytes.

#/components/schemas/actions-cache-stora.title: Actions cache storage limit for an enterprise
